audit.why: EVEN at 5.5/10 fits a 53.01% win rate over 3726 games: Karma owns the pre-6 poke war at 950 range with Mantra Q, Lux owns everything after Final Spark comes online.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart read 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content layer and the packet both read Karma/Karma/Karma/Skill/Lux/Lux/Lux. The page rendered two different answers to who wins each stage.
audit.why: Content win[0..6] already matches the packet levelChart, so the full layer is the wrong one. The spikes are real: Karma leads on early poke, Lux takes over at 6 with Final Spark (3340 range) and again on Luden's.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side -> Karma, phases[3].side stays Skill, phases[4..6].side -> Lux, with every why rewritten to match the new verdict and ratings adjusted.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions were unstated: Focused Resolve is a 675-range tether that only roots if unbroken, and it is 12s flat at every rank; Inspire grants move speed that helps her slip Light Binding; Mantra's cooldown is shortened by her damaging abilities.
audit.why: Riot's text: W tethers and roots 'if the tether is not broken'; E 'increases the Move Speed of the protected ally'; passive 'damaging abilities will reduce the cooldown of Mantra'.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns, Do's and Don'ts now state the 675 tether break, the 12s flat W, the 9s-to-5s Q and the 40s-to-34s Mantra.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal mention against Focused Resolve's Mantra healing.
audit.why: brief.missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal for this matchup.
audit.corrected: Itemization line now ends on anti-heal into her Mantra W healing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Seventeen fields used he/his for Karma; two bullets were the trade lines pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists karma as female; lintFindings names both bleeds.

audit.whatIsWrong: lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED: the body was the tradeGood string verbatim under an unrelated title.
audit.why: An earlier proposal targeted these same fields but its replacement text overshot the +/-10% length rule, so apply-proposals dropped the edit and the defect survived on disk.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to the same meaning inside the length budget, grounded in real ability names and cooldowns from champ-data/_kits: dosFull[1].d.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. Check it before every step-up. - W Prismatic Barrier is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Focused Resolve (Tether): 12s flat at every rank — break the tether with range or line of sight, then step up. - Inner Flame: 9s to 5s, her main poke. - Mantra: 40s to 34s, and her damage spells shorten it. - Your Q is 10s: hold it for her W.

notes: Chart repair: full-layer sides were all 'Skill' while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read Karma/Karma/Karma/Skill/Lux/Lux/Lux. I moved the full layer onto the content layer's values and rewrote every why in the same proposal. No win[N] edits are included because win[N] was already correct — the disagreement lived entirely in the full layer. phases[3] keeps 'Skill' and its rating; phases[4..6] keep their 6/10 ratings, which now read correctly as Lux-favoured. QA re-scope: previous edits to dosFull[1].d were rejected for length drift; re-proposed within budget. Cooldowns quoted are Riot per-rank values from the kit files; no spell-shield, cleanse or minion-block behaviour is asserted anywhere, since the kits do not state it.
